name: Hypothesis Test
description: Runs one or more hypothesis tests over the input and returns one row per comparison: test, statistic, df, p_value, n, comparison, p_adjusted, effect_size, effect_size_name, ci_low, ci_high. Parametric tests: two-sample (Welch) and paired Student's t, one-sample t, chi-square test of independence, one-way ANOVA. Nonparametric tests: Mann-Whitney U, Kruskal-Wallis H, Wilcoxon signed rank (normal approximation with tie correction). Tukey's HSD emits one row per group pair with the studentized-range p-value. correction none/bonferroni/holm/bh fills p_adjusted. p-values are computed by the engine's own incomplete beta/gamma implementation and the studentized range quadrature because DuckDB has no erf/beta.

value.title: Value column
value.description: Numeric measurement column for the t tests, ANOVA, Tukey and the rank tests, categorical column for chi_square.

group.title: Group column
group.description: Categorical grouping column for t_test_two_sample, chi_square, anova, mann_whitney, kruskal_wallis and tukey_hsd.

group_a.title: First group
group_a.description: t_test_two_sample/mann_whitney: a value of the group column, compared as text. t_test_paired/wilcoxon_signed_rank: the first numeric column.

group_b.title: Second group
group_b.description: t_test_two_sample/mann_whitney: a value of the group column, compared as text. t_test_paired/wilcoxon_signed_rank: the second numeric column.

alpha.title: Significance level
alpha.description: Validated to be in (0, 1); sets the confidence level of the effect-size interval.

alternative.title: Alternative hypothesis
alternative.description: Tail used by the t tests, mann_whitney and wilcoxon_signed_rank; chi_square, anova, kruskal_wallis and tukey_hsd always use the upper tail.

correction.title: Multiple comparison correction
correction.description: Adjusts p_adjusted over the rows the node emits: none, bonferroni, holm (step-down) or bh (Benjamini-Hochberg step-up).
